title: 纽约大学马库斯：AI安全规则应全球统一，中美需达成协议
speaker: Gary Marcus

segments.en: I mean that seems to be the debate right now the risk
segments.zh: 这似乎是当前的辩论焦点，风险。

segments.en: I mean they may be tempted as a form of protectionism in the same way that you know in the 1980s America was
segments.zh: 他们可能受到诱惑，将其作为一种保护主义形式，就像20世纪80年代的美国那样。

segments.en: I can't remember all the details but um was trying to
segments.zh: 我记不清所有细节，但嗯试图

segments.en: Find ways to put fees on Japanese cars which were cheaper and more reliable and so forth
segments.zh: 想办法对日本汽车收费，这些车更便宜、更可靠等等。

segments.en: So they might do it out of protectionism
segments.zh: 所以他们可能出于保护主义这样做。

segments.en: I think the rules around safety should be universal and I really think that US and China should make a deal around that
segments.zh: 我认为安全规则应该是全球统一的，我真的认为美国和中国应该就此达成协议。

segments.en: You know especially at the outer bounds of what might happen these
segments.zh: 尤其是在可能发生的最极端情况下，这些

segments.en: Countries should be in a communication about them
segments.zh: 国家应该就这些问题进行沟通。

segments.en: Errors that happen the incidents that happen and so forth going it alone here is not a great idea
segments.zh: 发生的错误、事件等等，单打独斗不是好主意。

segments.en: Where are we in this race between US and China here right now?
segments.zh: 目前中美在这场竞赛中处于什么位置？

segments.en: I mean you've argued that the US cannot win in this AI race
segments.zh: 你曾认为美国无法在这场AI竞赛中获胜。
